title: Exclusive: upliance.ai In Talks To Raise Up To $4 Mn For R&D, Global Expansion
script:
Upliance.ai is negotiating a funding round of up to four million dollars.
The D2C startup aims to use this capital for research and global expansion.
Co-founders Mahek Mody and Mohit Sharma previously launched this hardware venture in India.
Khosla Ventures is listed as a backer of the company.
The company focuses on creating intelligent kitchen hardware for modern households.
This fresh investment will help the team scale their engineering operations.
Would you let a robot handle your cooking?
